Hi Laura / BrightCart team —

Great to kick this off. Per our discovery call last week, here's a first-pass Mutual Action Plan to align marketplace listing + reseller coordination for the BrightCart evaluation and pilot. Attached: MAP_v0.1.xlsx (high-level milestones).

High-level asks from Redwood:
- Confirm target procurement window (we heard late July).
- Identify preferred purchase path: AWS Marketplace, Azure Marketplace, GCP Marketplace, or direct through reseller (EdgeReseller).
- Any mandatory vendor evidence (SOC2, data residency) we should prioritize.

Proposed owners (we can adjust):
- Marketplace listing (AWS): Camila Reyes (Redwood)
- Reseller contracting & onboarding: Marcus Lin (Redwood) + EdgeReseller
- Procurement pricing & procurement bundle: Rishi Malhotra (Redwood)
- Observability/usage SLAs + pricing tiers: Vanessa Ortiz (Redwood)

Can we set a 30-min weekly MAP checkpoint Wednesday mornings? I'll send a calendar invite if that works.

Thanks — Alex

Thanks Alex — this looks good. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- BrightCart procurement: our target is mid-August contract execution, but we need to lock the licensing model by end of July so we can reserve budget.
- We prefer AWS Marketplace for initial purchase if the listing supports consolidated billing; otherwise we may route via EdgeReseller.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II report + data handling overview for EU customers.

Can you add a checklist for differences between AWS vs Azure vs GCP (billing model, invoicing cadence, marketplace lead times)? Also please include a reseller handoff checklist.

1) Rishi: finalize recommended pricing bundles for AWS vs reseller by 6/24.
2) Camila: start AWS console prep and collect required artifacts (SaaS Security Profile, integration notes) — target 6/18.
3) Marcus: share reseller onboarding template and list of required legal fields for EdgeReseller by 6/21.
4) Alex: schedule weekly 30-min checkpoints (Weds 9am PT) and circulate agenda.

I've attached the expanded MAP (MAP_v0.2.xlsx) and our SaaS_Security_Profile.pdf for procurement review.

Next steps: please reply to confirm owners and dates — if we agree we'll lock the weekly cadence and I will start the calendar invites.

- AWS listing lead time: expect 2–3 weeks for initial review once we submit; plan for 7/1 submission to meet July procurement window.
